stats.name: MP regen
stats.note: MP restored every 4 ticks, through the status it brings.

stats.name: Armor
stats.note: A physical hit deals hit² ÷ (hit + 0.25 × Armor): nearly linear against big hits, never a blank.

stats.name: Aggro
stats.note: Centred on 100 (a word n is 70 + 10n, a gear or formation step 10), never below 1. Foes pick by draw, which comes from Aggro through ruleset.draw: an ordinary unit draws 100, none more than 300 or less than 33.

stats.name: Magic resist
stats.note: Step 5j: cuts each magical hit or pulse by this share; 100 is immune. Foes carry it by rank, and Ward gives it.

classes.name: Knight

passive.name: Phalanx
passive.text: Its basic attacks come half as often and deal double damage.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.text: Shelter against magic. Shelters the party from spells and curses, and brings down slow, heavy, burning judgement, half again as hard on any foe that holds a buff.

gear.name: Withering idol
gear.text: Its holder's basic attacks Weaken their target, and its hits on a Weakened foe deal a little more.

gear.name: Leech idol
gear.text: Siphon medium. MP it drains past its holder's full pool goes to the ally with the least MP.

gear.name: Idol of binding
gear.text: Foes its holder Weakens are also Slowed, and its hits on a foe that's both deal double.

gear.name: Idol of the hungry dark
gear.text: Every so often, it takes one buff from a foe and gives it to its holder.

gear.name: Horn of the keep
gear.text: Every hit the Knight takes gives the other ally with the least MP a tenth of the hit's damage as MP. When the Knight's Taunt runs out while another ally is in a wind-up, it Taunts again.

gear.name: Halo of the saint
gear.text: While an ally is knocked out, the part of the Cleric's heals that would go past full is kept. When it reaches a quarter of the Cleric's max HP, a fallen ally stands with that much.

gear.name: Huntmaster's quiver
gear.text: All the Ranger's abilities aim past any guard at the foe with the lowest HP. When a foe one of them hit falls, the cooldowns left on its abilities are halved.

gear.name: Heartwood mail
gear.text: Whenever a hit lands on any ally, the Bramble knight's Thorns strike the attacker too.

gear.name: The last wall
gear.text: When an Aegis the Hoplite gave blocks a blow, the attacker takes the blocked damage, and Aspis is ready again at once.

gear.name: Chains of light
gear.text: Smite also Silences its target. The Paladin's hits on a Stunned or Silenced foe heal the ally with the lowest share of HP for half the damage dealt.

gear.name: Stormspear
gear.text: A medium, magical, one-handed spear. Its basic attacks scale from Attack, ignore Taunt, and add a few Shock.

gear.name: Metronome
gear.text: Counts every hit the party lands. At 20, War ballad, Allegro and Thunder chord are ready at once, and the count starts again.

gear.name: The witch-blade
gear.text: After each ability the Hexer casts, its next three basic attacks hit every foe that holds a debuff.

gear.name: Ember palms
gear.text: Every hit the Monk lands adds a Burn. Every 5 ticks, it gains a Heat for each burning foe, up to three at a time.

gear.name: Night's edge
gear.text: When the Assassin lands a killing blow, it's Hidden for a moment, and its next hit deals double damage.

gear.name: Thrall's chalice
gear.text: When an ally falls, the Vampire heals to full. The next time the Vampire lands a killing blow, a fallen ally rises with a quarter of its max HP.

gear.name: Crown of embers
gear.text: While the Pyromancer stands, every ally's hits add a Burn.

gear.name: Glacier's heart
gear.text: Whenever a foe's Chill shatters, the Frostweaver puts half of it back: 6 Chill on that foe.

gear.name: Eye of the tempest
gear.text: Every hit the Stormcaller lands jumps to one more random foe for half its damage. When a foe falls holding Shock, every other foe gains half of it.
gear.note: Only basic attacks' and abilities' hits jump. A jump is an extra hit (X28), and a reaction to extra hits would hear its own jumps and loop, so Arc's and Double strike's extra strikes don't jump either.

gear.name: Mountain's crown
gear.text: Each crit the Geomancer lands rebuilds its own Shield by the damage the crit dealt.

positions.name: Blade

positions.name: Well

formations.name: The ambuscade

nodes.name: The Old Road
nodes.text: Bandits, wolves and snakes on the road out of town, and an ogre chief at the bridge.

nodes.name: The Road at Night
nodes.text: The same road after dark: more wolves, more arrows, and the chief has brought his brother.

nodes.name: Wildfire
nodes.text: The hills are crawling. Burn them out.

nodes.name: The Crypt
nodes.text: Armored bones, bats you can't hit, ghosts magic can't touch, and Death with a bell.

nodes.name: The Ossuary
nodes.text: Bone piled on bone. Break it.

nodes.name: The Ogre Brothers
nodes.text: Two chiefs, two clubs. Two walls to stand in front of them.

nodes.name: The Fire Mine
nodes.text: Everything here burns, and the lord of the furnace casts a fire that ends parties.

nodes.name: Deep Freeze
nodes.text: Put the mine's fires out, one by one.

nodes.name: Iron Wall
nodes.text: Only plate goes through the foundry.

nodes.name: The Ice Pass
nodes.text: Every fight asks what kind of hit you make. The Titan hides behind a shield of ice and armor like a glacier.

nodes.name: Valhalla
nodes.text: Fall, and rise ready.

nodes.name: The Wild Hunt
nodes.text: Everything that runs in packs, running faster. Don't stand still for it.

nodes.name: The Storm Tower

nodes.name: Knives Out
nodes.text: The weak ones hide behind the strong. Find them.

nodes.name: The Long Road
nodes.text: Seven fights and one campfire. Pace yourselves.

nodes.name: The Deep Crypt
nodes.text: Beneath the Crypt, something takes every voice. Power that isn't an ability is the key.

nodes.name: Blood Moon
nodes.text: The dead mend each other, and the chapel takes every voice. Drink deep, and keep singing. Pick your third.

nodes.name: Judgement
nodes.text: Spells, curses and cheering imps. Shelter the party, silence the casters, strike what's lifted up. Pick your third.

nodes.name: The Tower Top

nodes.name: The Royal Court

events.name: A Wounded Traveller
events.text: Someone lies hurt by the road, a weapon still in hand. They look like they can fight.

options.label: TAKE THEM IN
options.text: They join you, hurt: a third of their HP.

options.label: A LESSON
options.text: Patched up, they show one of yours a trick before they go: one member learns an ability or makes one better.

options.label: TAKE THEIR PURSE
options.text: +40 gold.

options.label: WALK ON
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.text: An altar, a bowl, and something glinting under the stone. The shrine wants blood.

options.label: OFFER BLOOD
options.text: Everyone loses 20% of max HP. A rare piece.

options.label: PRAY
options.text: Everyone recovers 15% of max HP.

options.label: LEAVE
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: The Gambler
events.text: A grinning stranger with a pair of bone dice. "Double or nothing?"

options.label: BET 40 GOLD
options.text: Half the time, win 100 back.

options.label: WALK AWAY
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: An Abandoned Forge
events.text: The coals are still warm. A smith could make something better here.

options.label: TEMPER A PIECE
options.text: A piece of your choice gains a rarity: common to uncommon, uncommon to rare.

options.label: SCRAP FOR GOLD
options.text: +30 gold from the scrap heap.

events.name: The Old Master
events.text: An old fighter sits by a fire. "I could teach one of you something. It will hurt."

options.label: LEARN THE HARD WAY
options.text: One member learns an ability; everyone loses 10% of max HP.

options.label: PAY 50 TO PRACTISE

options.label: LEAVE HIM BE
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: Ambush!
events.text: The road narrows between two rocks. Something is waiting up there.

options.label: FIGHT
options.text: A hard fight, with an elite's spoils.

options.label: RUN FOR IT
options.text: Everyone loses 10% of max HP.

events.name: A Clear Spring
events.text: Cold water bubbles up through the stones. It tastes of mana.

options.label: DRINK
options.text: Everyone recovers 50% of max MP and 10% of max HP.

options.label: BOTTLE IT
options.text: A tonic for later.

events.name: A Strange Chest
events.text: A chest in the middle of the road, unlocked. Too easy?

options.label: OPEN IT
options.text: Two times in three, a legendary piece. Otherwise it bites: a hard fight.

options.label: LEAVE IT
options.text: Nothing happens.

events.name: An Empty Camp
events.text: Someone left in a hurry: the fire is still burning, the bedrolls still laid out.

options.label: MAKE CAMP
options.text: A campfire: rest, focus, raise or train.

options.label: SEARCH THE PACKS
options.text: A potion, a tonic or a phoenix feather, and 20 gold.

options.label: DONATE 40
options.text: Everyone recovers 40% of max HP, and one fallen member rises at half HP (with nobody down, the healer gives you a phoenix feather).

options.label: PASS BY
options.text: Nothing happens.
